name: GenApi
positioning: Practice management for French notaries — where the deed, the file and the office accounting are one system.
description: GenApi, part of Septeo, publishes software for French notarial offices: file and deed production, clause and act libraries, client and party records, notarial accounting, electronic filing with the profession's infrastructure and secure exchange with administrations.
real_estate_use: In France the notaire, not a title company, carries the property transfer: drafting the acte authentique, collecting taxes, and registering with the service de publicité foncière. GenApi is one of the systems that production runs in, which makes it a structural dependency of every French property sale even though no agent ever logs into it.
features: Notarial file and deed production with maintained act libraries
Electronic exchange with the profession's platforms and administrations
Tax calculation and filing for property transfers
Document archiving to notarial retention requirements

use_cases.job: Draft, execute and register an acte authentique with its accounting and taxes
Keep client funds accounting to the standard the profession requires
